title: Recover the interrupted T15 attempt after host memory exhaustion

reproduction.reason: The interrupted attempt was recovered from durable objects instead of recreating the memory-exhausting execution pattern.

root_cause.summary: The interrupted T15 attempt exceeded safe host memory while too much unique work remained coupled to long-running process state.

repair_changes: inventory and preserve every recoverable local repository and evidence object before implementation
create an external rescue bundle, binary patches, streamed file hashes, and a Git bundle
adopt the existing T15 branch at the exact origin/dev source identity
enforce one memory-heavy job, one Factorio process, two implementation worktrees, and two lightweight lanes
write bounded immutable outputs and push durable checkpoints
regression_propositions: recovery inventory and rescue material exist before destructive cleanup
no more than one memory-heavy job or Factorio process runs at once
no more than two implementation worktrees or lightweight parallel lanes are active
accepted work is committed and pushed after bounded work packages
T15 resumes from matching durable evidence rather than recreating valid work
